findings.proposed_correction: Keep child action selection and numerical continuation separate, and bind every acquisition to the parent-assigned question in the decision input/prompt; remove the instruction that treats characterization as a reason to move into a different scientific task. Where the parent deliberately commissions a finite acquisition set, represent that source and its exhaustion explicitly using the existing source boundary, or commission the intended iterative scientific question instead of an exact one-operation task. Ordinary scoped refinements remain allowed when actually assigned. Broader work returns to the parent for its next assignment; do not introduce a result-quality gate, arbitrary turn cap, raw-child bypass, or a model-owned yield stop. Apply the same assignment semantics to credit projection (A1-F2). Proposed only.
findings.verification: In a later explicitly authorized experiment, commission distinct no-tide provenance and complete-model velocity-search questions. Verify the provenance child keeps the assigned force/state/trial scope and reports truthful source exhaustion if the declared source is finite; verify an iterative child continues by the unchanged numerical rule within its own question. Confirm both typed reports reach the immediate parent, every acquired operation remains one local turn, and no broader search occurs until that parent actually commissions it. No such experiment was run for this audit.

findings.proposed_correction: Supply each controller with the Episode target projection, derived from the same declared assignment/scientific target used for action selection and parent reporting. Use it for direct and child-projected observations alike. Preserve all reduced/scoped observations and their typed scientific findings; assign zero score contribution when they do not belong to this target, without rejecting the observations or making them pass another simulation. For a comparison goal covering multiple variants, explicitly declare the intended score target rather than silently using an all-variant maximum. Follow affected result, history and model-input consumers; preserve historical run artifacts. Proposed only; coordinate with A2 to avoid duplicate fixes.
findings.verification: A later authorized validation should use an assigned complete-model parent with a legitimate reduced-model child and a later small complete-model improvement. The reduced observation must remain durable and communicated while contributing no complete-target score; the complete-model improvement must enter that parent estimator once as the actual improvement. An explicitly reduced-target child should still receive its legitimate local score, and the root should still recompute its own scale without importing a child scalar. No fit, replay, simulation or test was run in this audit.
